_comment_top: QTD/TSS enabled Quantaureum mainnet config TEMPLATE. Not loaded by default.
_comment_usage: TEMPLATE ONLY. Complete DKG with the ceremony tooling, distribute the resulting encrypted shares and group key through the operator's approved secure channel, copy this file to a deployment-specific config, and edit dataDir / validatorKey / validatorEnabled. Start or restart nodes through the deployment supervisor.
_comment_tss_guards: TSS fields trigger 3 safety guards: node/config.go:823,854 and node/node.go:2963 (RPC-M1). Guards REQUIRE: tssKeyShareFile path exists AND is decryptable with TSS_PASSWORD env var, tssGroupKeyFile path exists. Loading fails => node refuses to start.
_comment_password: TSS password via env var TSS_PASSWORD on each node, NOT in JSON. Supply it through the deployment supervisor's secret mechanism; do not store it in this template.
name: qau-node

bridge._comment: Cross-chain bridge config (mainnet). QAU_ENABLE_BRIDGE=1 env var required to enable.

_tss_comment: === QTD/TSS fields (NEW). DO NOT enable these until DKG ceremony outputs are deployed ===
_tss_threshold_comment: tssThreshold=4 of 6 => BFT quorum 2/3+1, tolerates up to 2 Byzantine validators
_tss_distributed_mode_comment: tssDistributedMode=true required on mainnet (Validate-2 guard at config.go:854). Each node holds only its own share and signs via P2P.
_tss_keyshare_path_comment: Per-node file path. Each operator installs only its assigned encrypted TSS share at this path.
_tss_groupkey_path_comment: Per-node file path for the common non-secret TSS group public key.
